scope: top reserved CAM5/6 ABI, prep_regs_u/u_motion_register_bank capture and mapped AXI read cones

method.input: Current-run mapped_dump.v primitive instances, INIT tables and connected pins; frozen sources used only for intended ABI
method.evaluation: Read-only Python in-memory parser. LUT index=sum(Ii*2**i); unknown leaves={0,1}, propagated conservatively. L5 uses low 32 INIT bits; LUT7 selects A/B by M; LUT8 selects A/B by M0, C/D by M1 and pair by M2. Register Q leaves represent held state; registered data cones evaluated before clocking.
method.semantics_limit: Boolean interpretation of mapped LUT INIT and mux pins; no vendor primitive simulation, sequential formal equivalence, or hardware test.
method.evidence_source: mapped_dump.v; ADIF mapped_dump.txt hashed but not independently connectivity-crosschecked

capture_mux.result: Indices 0..3 select CAM1..4 corresponding bit; indices 4 and 5 select zero regardless of all four active record bit values

remaining_limits: No full AXI protocol or sequential equivalence pass: upstream N9 qualification, ready/valid timing, reset transitions, and generation carry arithmetic not exhaustively evaluated.
Reserved packet zero applies after enabled valid CAM5/6 capture or reset. Changing selector without capture retains previous snapshot.
Core RAM history, detector pipeline/control and physical timing are separate scope.
actionable_followup: For full interface acceptance prove N9 write-page/offset predicate and AXI sequential handshake using this exact export. No reserved-camera packet mux gap remains under stated primitive semantics.
